items.name: Full access
items.description: Unrestricted: every communication capability enabled (the default for new agents).

items.name: Coordinator
items.description: Orchestrates the swarm: everything enabled, including broadcasts, handoff creation and cancellation.

items.name: Worker
items.description: Executes work: direct messages and handoff claim/complete only - no broadcasts, no handoff creation or cancellation, no channel creation.

items.name: Observer
items.description: Read-only: watches the event stream but sends nothing and never touches handoffs or artifacts.

descriptions.messages.send_direct: Send direct messages to a specific agent.
descriptions.messages.send_broadcast: Fan out to groups: broadcast, by role or by capability.
descriptions.events.read: Read or wait on the workspace event stream (event_get / event_wait).
descriptions.observations.manage_self: Manage own observed instances within operator-approved sources and workspaces. Token issuance also requires observations.publish.
descriptions.observations.publish: Publish external activity for this agent's approved observation instances. Does not authorize messages, runtime execution or source administration.
descriptions.identity.update_profile: Update its own role and metadata through agent_register.
descriptions.identity.update_capabilities: Update its own advertised capabilities through agent_register.
descriptions.workspaces.include_paths: Include workspace root paths in workspace_list.
descriptions.shared_md.render: Render the derived shared.md workspace file.
descriptions.health.read: Read coordination health metrics for a workspace.
descriptions.experimental.memory_read: Read experimental workspace memories by id.
descriptions.limits.messages_per_minute: Max messages this agent may send per minute (0 = unlimited).
descriptions.limits.max_recipients: Max recipients a single group send may fan out to (0 = unlimited).
